title: Maximum Holes per Delay Summary
notes: Simplifies the 8 ms timing result to the maximum holes per delay across the full Shot Diagram.
Shows a clear headline such as 1 hole per delay, 2 holes per delay, or 3 holes per delay.
Calculates the maximum number of eligible timed holes within any timing window shorter than 8 ms; exactly 8 ms remains acceptable.
Keeps the detailed timing-pair list collapsed until Show Timing Conflicts is selected.
Preserves the existing conflict details, exclusions, cloud sync, standardized JSON backups, Drill Log conversion, and timing-fill behavior.
